verdict.rationale: Feitian provides a dedicated setup portal with guides for pairing Bluetooth keys, registering keys to platforms (Microsoft, Azure AD, general online accounts), OpenSSH/GitHub setup, and companion tools (SK Manager, iePassManager) for managing FIDO/PIV/OTP functions — this constitutes real guided documentation for first-time setup across multiple use cases. However, evidence is all vendor-hosted docs pages/link descriptions without screenshots, step-by-step walkthroughs, or independent confirmation that the guidance is clear/beginner-friendly. Missing for 10: hands-on or third-party validation of setup clarity, an integrated setup wizard/app experience (vs. separate web docs), and evidence of walkthroughs for less common account types beyond Microsoft/Google/SSH.
